benign.text: Blood pressure follows a daily rhythm. It tends to rise in the hours after you wake up, as your body releases hormones that get you moving. A higher number in the morning is common.

Sleep and morning blood pressure often move together. After shorter nights, morning readings can run a little higher.
Taking readings at the same times each day makes it easier to see your pattern.
